data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Nikolaos, meaning 'victory of the people'. The name Nicolai has been popular in Christian traditions, notably in the Eastern Orthodox Church. The name Nicolai carries the meaning “Victory of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nicolai usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and triumph over adversity.
data.etymology: Nicolai belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory of the people.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nicolai total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Nicolai has been carried by numerous renowned figures in history, including saints, monarchs, and artists. Saint Nicolas, the legendary 4th-century bishop known for his charitable acts and gift-giving in the lead-up to Christmas, was one of the most venerated saints in Europe.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Nicolai holds deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the power of generosity, compassion, and victory over worldly struggles. It serves as a reminder to be generous and compassionate, embodying the virtues of love and kindness that Saint Nicolas demonstrated throughout his life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Nicolai carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Biblical tradition. As a name associated with Saint Saint Nicholas, it represents holiness, devotion, and Christian virtue.
